name: review-request-sender
description: A few days after an order is delivered, asks the customer to review what they bought, with a direct link. Skips anyone with an open complaint, return or refund, and never asks twice for the same order.

howItWorks.label: Finds
howItWorks.text: Orders delivered a set number of days ago, from customers who accept marketing email

howItWorks.label: Skips
howItWorks.text: Orders with an open complaint, return or refund, and orders already asked about

howItWorks.label: Asks
howItWorks.text: Through a Klaviyo flow, or a short Resend email you approve, linking to the review page

plugins.reason: Sets the review request on the customer's profile so your Klaviyo flow sends it, with Klaviyo's own consent and unsubscribe handling
Sends each approved review request directly

data.description: When the order was delivered (or shipped, when delivery is not tracked)
Whether the order was refunded, returned or cancelled
The customer's first name, for the greeting
Whether the customer agreed to receive marketing email
The page where a product is reviewed, when each product has its own
A complaint, support ticket or return linked to the order or customer

parameters.label: Days after delivery
parameters.description: Ask this many days after the order arrived, once the customer has had time to use it

parameters.label: Review link
parameters.description: The review page, e.g. https://northline.example/reviews?product={handle}; used when products have no review URL of their own

parameters.label: Products per request
parameters.description: For larger orders, ask about at most this many products

parameters.label: Requests per run
parameters.description: The most requests in one run; the rest wait for tomorrow

parameters.label: Where customers reply
parameters.description: The address for replies when sending with Resend, e.g. hello@northline.example
